title: Dexcom G6 data collection fails after a week
body:
My Dexcom G6 transmitter serial starts with 81. I have been using this transmitter for about 6 months. I have never been able to use sensors with Xdrip for more than a week. After a week, the BG readings starts being very noisy and it stops (sensor errors).
When I use the Dexcom patched apps, I don't have any problem. I can use the sensors for more than 10 days.
Have anyone experienced this issue?

comments.body: Where do you wear your sensors? Do they bleed? Do you refixate the sensor when it starts to come off?
Download the newest version and see if that helps, 12-22-19 version

@2018johnsmith Would you please close this issue if your questions have been answered already.

The only difference between the two scenarios you have described is the Dexcom calibration versus the xDrip calibration.  But, you can use xDrip in Native mode, in which case, xDrip will only act as an intermediary and the transmitter will handle the calibration.  What I mean by calibration is the conversion of raw data to blood glucose values.

You can also consult with others in the xDrip support group on facebook.
https://www.facebook.com/groups/xDripG5
Or in the Gitter room.  https://gitter.im/jamorham/xDrip-plus

Thanks
